column18: Article distinguishes Jawangkhola, Tikrang and Galchhi/Bereini points. Independently dated July 1 morning reopening reports confirm the overnight/morning road failures despite ambiguous “Thursday night” phrasing. Flood-swollen other rivers are not slope-failure events.
